items.claim: 全年現金使用財測維持122–128百萬美元，不含潛在合作夥伴付款
items.quote: cash use guidance for the year remain unchanged
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: Q1期末現金與投資175.6百萬、當季現金使用42.2百萬，CFO稱符合計畫
items.quote: our cash use this quarter was 42.2 million
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: Q1 R&D費用29.6百萬，低於2008年Q1，聚焦近期價值程式
items.quote: R&D expense totaled 29.6 million
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO回答R&D費用走勢今年將相當平穩
items.quote: It should look pretty flat this year, Tom.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO解釋Q1為現金消耗季節性最高季，因付息與營運資金支出
items.quote: So Q1 is seasonally the highest quarter for our burn.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO承認可轉債餘額構成重大財務overhang
items.quote: represents a significant financial overhang
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 管理層稱有多種重組或減少可轉債的選項，處理債務將以股東價值最大化為焦點，但不公開討論
items.quote: will be focused on maximizing shareholder value
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 已重新提交SPA，若FDA同意，預計上半年啟動myelofibrosis樞紐性Phase III
items.quote: we remain in a position to start our pivotal Phase III
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 預期歐洲註冊試驗將於一個月左右內開始，每項試驗約需六個月收案
items.quote: take about six months to enroll each of these studies
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 仍預期於2010年底或2011年初完成試驗並申報NDA
items.quote: filing the NDA in late 2010 or early 2011
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: INCB28050口服JAK抑制劑類風濕關節炎六個月Phase II，預期2010上半年出結果
items.quote: results of the trial in the first half of 2010
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: INCB13739糖尿病試驗中期分析摘要獲ADA晚期海報接受，最終數據預計6月初
items.quote: we expect to have the final data in early June
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 424於PV與ET的Phase II已完成收案，預計ASH發表，管理層稱安全性與療效結果令人鼓舞
items.quote: This study is fully enrolled
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 外用424乾癬Phase IIb結果預計夏末
items.quote: we look forward to having results late this summer
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: JAK腫瘤計畫意圖保留北美權利，但若條件有吸引力會考慮美國以外合作
items.quote: It remains our intent to keep North American rights
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: JAK發炎計畫可做全球授權，或保留部分適應症／分享下游經濟利益
items.quote: we could do a broad global licensing deal
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO結語列出最高優先：開始MF註冊試驗，並以合作改善財務狀況
items.quote: improve our financial position by partnering
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 被問若無法與FDA達成SPA是否仍進行，CEO稱想要SPA但不拘泥
items.quote: We very much like to have the SPA. We are not wedded to it.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: c-MET前臨床資產合作為相當高優先，但對改善資產負債表的幫助不如發炎或MPD交易
items.quote: it doesn't move the needle as a pre-clinical entity
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: sheddase需待與Herceptin合用於轉移性乳癌的試驗完成後才較易取得價值；IDO尚未嘗試合作
items.quote: we've not attempted to partner at this point in time
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CMO說明外用乾癬藥療效門檻：維他命D/A類似物約20%達clear或almost clear，近期核准藥約23%
items.quote: you get responses in the 20% range
items.speaker: CMO

items.claim: CEO稱其c-MET分子是c-MET抑制劑中最佳
items.quote: we think we have the best molecule of the c-MET inhibitors
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO說明13739中期分析僅涵蓋約35%最終收案病人，提醒勿先下假設
items.quote: interim analysis was done on about 35% of the patients
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CMO稱FDA對SPA並非全有全無，其樂觀認為可核准或小幅修改
items.quote: we're pretty optimistic that we either get approval
items.speaker: CMO

items.claim: 13739夥伴洽談：因最終數據只需再七週，決定等到6月初再重新接觸對象
items.quote: We started to wait until early June
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO稱JAK發炎計畫興趣濃厚
items.quote: There is a lot of interest in that program.
items.speaker: CEO

qa_flags.question: 第二版SPA的試驗設計與原先構想相比變動多少？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 拒絕說明設計，稱待FDA同意後再提供清楚描述，僅重申NDA時程

qa_flags.question: 是否嘗試以有利條件回購可轉債，若無原因為何？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未回答是否嘗試回購，僅稱不願透露策略細節、以股東價值最大化為準

qa_flags.question: JAK按適應症拆分授權是否被合作方視為問題？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 稱難以深入，僅表示分子不同已將問題降到最低，不再進一步評論
